name: Mugg & Bean On The Move Wilderness
address: Building 1, Milkwood Village, Beacon Rd, Spar, Wilderness, 6560, South Africa
description_short: Reliable Mugg & Bean grab-and-go spot in Wilderness for quality coffee, generous breakfasts, and quick meals.
description_long:
This compact Mugg & Bean On The Move at Milkwood Village offers the franchise's signature generous portions and reliable quality in a convenient format. Perfect for travellers passing through Wilderness or locals popping in for their morning coffee fix, the spot delivers familiar favourites without the full sit-down experience.

Expect freshly brewed coffee, hearty all-day breakfasts, substantial sandwiches, and those famous giant muffins. The location inside the Spar complex makes it ideal for grabbing supplies and a decent meal in one stop. It's straightforward, consistent, and gets you fed without fuss – exactly what you need when you're exploring the Garden Route and don't want to spend an hour at a table.
